title: I'm developing with many AI friends an isometric racing game with engine LAB and generative DSP audio by engine architechture, SPEED-VALLEY
author: Moist_Upstairs_4584
selftext:
Speedvalley has changing weather, a road rubbering in, or a dirt road getting rutted as cars pass.

An engine room with my own DSP which generates engine sound given by cyl number and every parameters.

You can also improve your own car with parts, or just swap engine.

Rally cars and GT
